annotations.title: Top up credit for paid calls

description: How prepaid credit for paid calls is bought: POST /api/paid/find-tools with your key then takes $0.01 a call from it, with no rate limit, and answers at once. The top-up is paid over HTTP 402, as with pay_order: a POST to the url with body {"amount_usd": 5 | 20 | 50} and no credential answers 402 with the challenges (MPP: a card through a Stripe Shared Payment Token, or USDC on Tempo or Base; x402: USDC on Base), and the same request with the credential pays. The idempotency_key from this answer, as the Idempotency-Key header on both requests, makes a retry never pay twice. With your API key the credit goes onto your account; without one the top-up makes an agent account and returns its key, which holds the credit. A balance holds at most $100 and lasts 12 months from the last top-up. It pays for calls only, not a report or a drive. The price includes any VAT, and every top-up has a receipt. With a key this also gives your balance now, and needed: false while it is above 50 calls.

amount_usd.description: The top-up in US dollars: 5, 20, 50. 5 buys 500 calls.
